**P2 — Drain each case before starting the next**

When a case fails, this releases gates but leaves its invocation futures and durable retries active until `Cloud.close()` after all 13 cases. A failed holder or replay can therefore consume the fixture's single environment and create cascading, invalid failures in later cases. Track the invocation index per case and stop/drain every newly launched item in this `finally`; abort further cases if isolation cannot be restored.
